person.note: Al-Sakhāwī adds "and I think he is the one who passed shortly before" (wa-aẓunnuhu al-māḍī qarīban): most likely Tanam Sayf al-Dīn al-Ḥasanī al-Ẓāhirī (AIND-D02315), nāʾib of Damascus, killed in 802 H. Proposed corresp pending editorial approval.
タナム。タンバクとも呼ばれた。ダマスカス総督（ナーイブ）。802年に没した。おそらく少し前に既出の人物と同一であろう（サハーウィー自身の推定）。
Tanam, also called Tanbak, nāʾib of Damascus. He died in 802 H. I (al-Sakhāwī) think he is the one treated shortly before.
